field.label: Enable automatic backups
field.help: Enable backup operations. For scheduling add Yandex Disk Backup to System - Settings - Cron.

field.label: Yandex OAuth token
field.help: Token with Yandex.Disk permissions cloud_api:disk.read and cloud_api:disk.write. When saved, the field shows masked dots. Leave empty to keep the existing token.

field.label: Remote folder
field.help: A path relative to the Yandex.Disk root, e.g. OPNsense-Backups/Home. Folder will be created when backing up.

field.label: Copies to keep
field.help: Keep the latest 1-365 copies belonging to this firewall. Older copies go to the Disk trash.
